message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (~182 g or 8 oz) typically contains **about 95 kilocalories** (kcal).  
Calories can vary slightly:

| Apple Size | Approximate Weight | Calories |
|------------|--------------------|----------|
| Small      | 149 g               | 77–80    |
| Medium     | 182 g               | 95       |
| Large      | 223 g               | 115–120  |

These figures assume a standard “red delicious” or similar variety without added sugars or toppings. If you’re tracking macros precisely, weigh your fruit and adjust accordingly!
